_note: JQ · 7th grade · basketball and soccer. Functionally identical to the original: the same five equations in the same order, the same show-your-working board, the same hints and walkthrough structure. Only the skin and the stories differ.
_nameNote: Renamed from 'Smart Girl Algebra' because JQ is a boy — the original name on his screen would land badly. Kept the 'Smart _ Algebra' family so it still reads as the same product. Change this line if you want it called something else.
name: Smart Court Algebra
tagline: Math, but make it game day. Pick your matchup. 🏀
howToPlay: Read the problem, then solve it one line at a time. Tap Check! after every line and we'll tell you exactly where it went wrong. Stuck? Grab a hint or tap Show me how.
footerNote: No sign-up, no passwords — just you, the numbers, and the win.
_themeNote: Green and gold. accentFg is deep green rather than white, because white on gold fails contrast.

levels.name: Shootaround
levels.cheer: You had some balls in the equipment bag. Coach tossed in 4 more, and now there are 10. 🏀
levels.question: How many were in the bag to start?
hints: The x is stuck with a “+ 4”. That has to go.
Subtract 4 from BOTH sides. Keep it balanced.

walkthrough.title: Find the goal
walkthrough.body: We want x on its own. Right now it has “+ 4” attached.

levels.name: Two-Point Night
levels.tagline: Multiply AND add. Two things at once.
levels.cheer: You scored 2 points every time you drove the lane, plus you hit 5 points from the free-throw line. You finished with 23. 🏀
levels.question: How many times did you drive the lane?
hints: Deal with the lonely number first. That + 5 goes.

walkthrough.title: Read the play
walkthrough.body: x is squeezed by a “times 2” and a “plus 5.” Peel them off one at a time.

walkthrough.title: Split it evenly
walkthrough.body: x is times 2, so divide BOTH sides by 2. 18 ÷ 2 = 9.

levels.name: Both Ends of the Pitch
levels.tagline: x is on the left AND the right.
levels.cheer: Your team scores 3 goals a half but conceded 4 all game. That somehow equals 1 goal a half plus the 8 the keeper saved. ⚽
levels.question: How many halves are we talking about?
hints: Get all the x's onto ONE side first.
Add 4 to both sides → 2x = 12, then divide by 2. x = 6.

walkthrough.title: Round up the x's
walkthrough.body: Subtract x from BOTH sides so every x lives on the left.

levels.name: Squad Rotation
levels.cheer: Coach triples every group of (x minus 1) starters. That has to match one x plus the 7 players on the bench. ⚽
levels.question: How many starters are in each group?
hints: First, share the 3 with EVERYTHING inside the brackets.
Get x's together, numbers together → 2x = 10 → x = 5.

walkthrough.title: Distribute the 3
walkthrough.body: Multiply the 3 by each thing inside: 3·x and 3·(−1).

walkthrough.title: Free the number, then split
walkthrough.body: Add 3 to both sides → 2x = 10, then divide by 2.

levels.name: Corner to Corner
levels.tagline: Squares, triangles, and one legendary theorem. 🏆
levels.cheer: You're running a diagonal sprint across the corner of the pitch. The two straight sides are 6 m and 8 m. You need the diagonal. Pythagoras says: leg² + leg² = hypotenuse². ⚽
levels.question: How long is the diagonal, x?
hints: Square the two sides first: 6² means 6 × 6, and 8² means 8 × 8. 📐
What number times itself is 100? That's the square root. x = 10.

walkthrough.title: Meet Pythagoras
walkthrough.body: For a right triangle, the two short sides squared and added equal the long side squared.

walkthrough.title: Un-square it
walkthrough.body: x² = 100, so x is the number that times itself makes 100. That's 10.
